name: What is the difference between satin and semi-gloss paint for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between satin and semi-gloss paint for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both satin and semi-gloss finishes are suitable for bathrooms, offering durability and moisture resistance, but they differ in sheen and appearance. Semi-gloss has a higher sheen than satin, making it more reflective, brighter, and typically easier to clean. It's often chosen for trim, doors, and areas needing maximum durability. Satin offers a softer, low-sheen look that hides minor imperfections better than semi-gloss, while still providing good moisture resistance and washability for walls. The choice often comes down to personal aesthetic preference and the level of sheen desired. City Dweller, LLC can advise on which finish best suits your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Semi-gloss has a higher sheen and is easier to clean, ideal for trim. Satin has a softer, lower sheen, hiding imperfections better while still resisting moisture.
